name: Inkling 2 Mini · Vision · vLLM XPU · DSpark
description: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B looped MoE, 3.4B active), the unmodified native NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint (ed40e7da), on vLLM 0.34.0rc1.dev1133 XPU + mgaruccio/vllm-inkling2-xpu, following SergiioB's cookbook route (upstream d1e3506): vLLM PR #69186 patch, AOT bmg_g31 NVFP4 CUTLASS Xe2 MoE, SYCL decode attention, XPU vision tower, FP8 KV, DSpark k=7. 128K context. Sergio measured about 68 tok/s at 64K and 2,900 to 3,900 tok/s prompt reading with this profile on one B70. Prefix caching on (2026-11-24, checked against a cache-off baseline).
